$comment: Generated by states/discover.mjs (run `pnpm run test:states` or `node states/discover.mjs --write`). Do not edit.

columns.empty: n/a: An accordion always has its items; with none there is nothing to render.
columns.loading: n/a: The fold is static; each panel owns loading.
columns.error: n/a: The fold cannot fail; each panel owns errors.

columns.lifecycle: n/a: The feed holds no lifecycle of its own beyond Show more, which overflow covers.

columns.empty: n/a: An alert always says something; with nothing to say it is not shown.
columns.loading: n/a: An alert reports a settled state; work in progress shows the loading recipe.

columns.empty: n/a: An alert dialog always asks a question; it never opens empty.
columns.loading: n/a: The question is known before it opens; the answer's work runs after it closes.
columns.overflow: n/a: The question is a sentence; a long read belongs in Dialog.

columns.empty: n/a: The frame always holds a main slot; its emptiness is the page's empty state.
columns.loading: n/a: The frame renders at once; loading belongs to the page inside it.
columns.error: n/a: The frame has no failure state; errors belong to the page inside it.

columns.empty: n/a: An avatar with nothing known about the person draws the placeholder glyph; populated covers it.
columns.lifecycle: n/a: An avatar does not change after it renders except for the image load, which loading covers.

columns.empty: n/a: A badge always carries words; with nothing to say it is not shown.
columns.loading: n/a: A badge reports a settled fact; work in progress shows the loading recipe.
columns.error: n/a: A badge has no failure of its own; the danger tone is a populated state.

columns.empty: n/a: An empty box is a blank plane; the region that owns it draws the empty state.
columns.loading: n/a: A plane never waits on anything; Skeleton fills the content inside it.
columns.error: n/a: A plane has no failure of its own; Alert owns state panels.
columns.lifecycle: n/a: A plane never changes after it renders.

columns.empty: n/a: No items means no trail; the caller renders nothing.
columns.loading: n/a: The trail is static; the page that owns it shows loading.
columns.error: n/a: The trail is static; the page that owns it shows errors.

columns.empty: n/a: A button is always labelled, so it is never empty.
columns.error: n/a: Errors show at the field or the form, never on the button.

columns.empty: n/a: A fused group always holds its two actions.
columns.loading: n/a: Pending belongs to the Button inside the group.
columns.error: n/a: Errors show at the field or the form, never on the group.

columns.empty: n/a: A card with nothing in it is not shown; no data is an EmptyState inside the card.
columns.loading: n/a: A card never waits itself; Skeleton rows in the loaded shape sit inside it.

columns.empty: n/a: A checkbox always has its box; unchecked is a value, not an empty state.
columns.loading: n/a: A checkbox holds a local value; the form that saves it owns loading.
n/a: A chip shows a value that is already known.
columns.error: n/a: A chip carries no validation of its own; the field around it does.

columns.empty: n/a: A code block always holds code; with nothing to show, leave it out.
n/a: A collapsible always has a trigger; empty content is the caller's to avoid.
columns.loading: n/a: The fold is static; the content owns loading.
columns.error: n/a: The fold cannot fail; the content owns errors.

columns.empty: n/a: A colour picker always holds a colour.
columns.overflow: n/a: A hex value has a fixed length; the field never overflows.

columns.empty: n/a: The provider renders no element; there is nothing to be empty.
columns.loading: n/a: The provider renders no element; nothing loads.
columns.error: n/a: The provider renders no element; it has no error state.
columns.overflow: n/a: The provider renders no element; its children own their overflow.
columns.lifecycle: n/a: The provider renders no element; it has no interaction states.

columns.empty: n/a: A calendar always shows a month; an unset value shows the placeholder (populated shows the set one).
columns.loading: n/a: Dates are computed in the browser; the calendar keeps its six-week footprint as a skeleton while its dependency resolves.

columns.empty: n/a: A dialog always carries a task; it never opens empty.
n/a: A drawer opens on something to show; a list inside it shows its own empty state.

columns.loading: n/a: TipTap resolves before first paint in the harness; the markdown textarea stands in until it does.

columns.empty: n/a: EmptyState is itself the empty state of the region that holds it.
columns.loading: n/a: A region that is still loading shows Skeleton rows, not an empty state.
columns.error: n/a: A failure is an Alert with a retry, never an empty state.
columns.lifecycle: n/a: An empty state never changes after it renders; the region swaps it out.

columns.empty: n/a: A field always holds a label and a control.
columns.loading: n/a: A field frames one control; the control shows its own loading.

columns.empty: n/a: A fieldset exists to group controls; it always holds some.
columns.loading: n/a: A fieldset holds no data of its own; its controls show their own loading.

columns.empty: n/a: A form exists to hold fields; it always has some.

columns.loading: n/a: A layout primitive draws nothing that loads; its children own their waiting state.
columns.error: n/a: A layout primitive takes no input and fetches nothing, so it cannot fail.

columns.empty: n/a: A header always carries at least the brand or the trigger; an empty bar is not shown.
columns.loading: n/a: The bar renders with the page; nothing in it loads.
columns.error: n/a: The bar has no failure state; errors belong to the page below it.

columns.empty: n/a: An icon is a glyph; it holds no data, so it is never empty.
columns.loading: n/a: The glyph is inline SVG from the caller; nothing loads.
columns.error: n/a: An icon takes no input and fetches nothing, so it cannot fail.
columns.overflow: n/a: A glyph is a fixed square on the ladder; it never overflows.

columns.empty: n/a: An icon button always carries its glyph and an accessible name.
columns.error: n/a: Errors show at the field or the form, never on the button.
columns.overflow: n/a: A glyph on a square track cannot overflow.

columns.empty: n/a: An image always has a source; a missing one is the error state.

columns.loading: n/a: An input holds what the person types; nothing loads into it.

columns.empty: n/a: A keycap always names a key; with no key there is nothing to draw.
columns.loading: n/a: A keycap is static text and never waits on anything.
columns.error: n/a: A keycap has no failure of its own; the control it hints at owns the error.
columns.lifecycle: n/a: A keycap never changes after it renders.

columns.empty: n/a: A link always names its destination.
columns.loading: n/a: Navigation has no pending state on the link itself.
columns.error: n/a: A broken destination is the page's error, not the link's.

columns.empty: n/a: A list renders the items it is given; with none, the surface around it shows EmptyState.
columns.loading: n/a: A list that is waiting is Skeleton rows (shape="row") in its place; Skeleton proves them.
columns.error: n/a: A list never fetches; the surface that loads its items shows the errbox.

columns.loading: n/a: A listbox renders the options it is given; the surface that fetches them shows loading.
columns.error: n/a: A listbox renders the options it is given; the surface that fetches them shows the error.

columns.populated: n/a: Loading is the loading state; the result replaces it.
columns.empty: n/a: A spinner stands in for a result that is coming; an empty result shows EmptyState.
columns.error: n/a: A spinner never fails; a failed wait replaces it with the errbox recipe.
columns.overflow: n/a: A spinner has one fixed size; its label is read, not shown.

columns.empty: n/a: The form starts empty; populated is that first paint.
columns.loading: n/a: A sign-in has nothing to load; pending submit is in lifecycle.
columns.overflow: n/a: The copy is fixed and short; the fields scroll their own text.

columns.loading: n/a: Main is the page frame; loading shows in the content it holds.
columns.error: n/a: Main is the page frame; errors show in the content it holds.
columns.lifecycle: n/a: Main has no interactive states.

columns.empty: n/a: An empty string renders nothing; the reply shows ThinkingIndicator until words arrive.
columns.error: n/a: Markdown never fails: without the parser it degrades to plain paragraphs.

columns.empty: n/a: A menu renders the actions it is given; with no actions there is no menu to open.
columns.error: n/a: A menu holds actions only; an action that fails reports where it ran.

columns.empty: n/a: A message always carries words; an empty conversation is ConversationList's emptyState.

columns.loading: n/a: A number field holds its own value; nothing loads into it.
n/a: Pagination counts pages the ledger already knows.
columns.error: n/a: Pagination counts pages the ledger already knows.

columns.empty: n/a: A popover shows the content it is given; with nothing to show it is not opened.
columns.loading: n/a: A popover has no loading state of its own; content that loads inside it shows the skeleton recipe.
columns.error: n/a: A popover has no error state of its own; a failure inside it shows the errbox recipe.

columns.empty: n/a: A bar at 0 is a value like any other; no work at all shows no bar.
columns.error: n/a: A bar never fails; the surface that runs the work replaces it with the errbox recipe.

columns.empty: n/a: A radio group always has its options.
columns.loading: n/a: A radio group holds a local value; the form that saves it owns loading.

columns.empty: n/a: An empty area has nothing to scroll; the caller shows its own empty state.
columns.loading: n/a: The area is a frame; its content owns loading.
columns.error: n/a: The area cannot fail; its content owns errors.

columns.empty: n/a: A select with no options is a configuration error; the surface that loads them shows empty.
columns.loading: n/a: A select renders the options it is given; the surface that fetches them shows loading.

columns.empty: n/a: A rule holds no data; without a label it is still one hairline.
columns.loading: n/a: A rule draws nothing that loads.
columns.error: n/a: A rule takes no input and fetches nothing, so it cannot fail.
n/a: Navigation has no failure state of its own; a row that cannot load is disabled.

columns.populated: n/a: A skeleton is the loading state; the loaded content replaces it.
columns.empty: n/a: A skeleton stands in for content that is coming; an empty result shows EmptyState.
columns.error: n/a: A skeleton never fails; a failed load replaces it with the errbox recipe.
columns.overflow: n/a: A skeleton takes the geometry it is given and never holds text.
columns.lifecycle: n/a: The swap from skeleton to content belongs to the caller; FeedbackRecipe proves it lands in place.

columns.empty: n/a: A slider always holds a value; the minimum is a value, not an empty state.
columns.loading: n/a: A slider moves locally and instantly; a server-backed setting shows pending on its own action.
n/a: A layout primitive draws nothing that loads; its children own their waiting state.
columns.error: n/a: A layout primitive takes no input and fetches nothing, so it cannot fail.
n/a: A metric that failed to load is a missing value, which empty covers with an em dash.
columns.lifecycle: n/a: The card holds no state; it shows what it is given.

columns.empty: n/a: Off is a value, not an empty state; the switch always has its track.
columns.loading: n/a: A switch toggles locally and instantly; a server-backed setting shows pending on its own action.

columns.error: n/a: Table renders the rows it is given; the surface that fetches them shows the error (DataTable carries the errbox row).

columns.loading: n/a: Headings are known when the page renders; nothing loads.
columns.error: n/a: Headings are known when the page renders; nothing can fail.

columns.empty: n/a: A tab row always has its tabs; with none there is nothing to render.
columns.loading: n/a: The tab row is static; the panel owns loading, and a count shows `…` while counting.
columns.error: n/a: The tab row cannot fail; the panel owns errors.

columns.empty: n/a: Text with nothing to say is not rendered; the surface around it owns the empty state.
columns.loading: n/a: Text never waits; a loading line is a Skeleton bar.
columns.error: n/a: Text has no failure of its own; the danger ink is a populated state.
columns.lifecycle: n/a: Text never changes after it renders except through new children.

columns.loading: n/a: A textarea holds what the person types; nothing loads into it.

columns.empty: n/a: A Theme with no children still scopes nothing visible; there is no empty state to draw.
columns.overflow: n/a: A Theme draws no box of its own size; its children own overflow.

columns.empty: n/a: The indicator always says what the assistant is doing.
n/a: A toast always says what happened; it never shows empty.
n/a: A segmented control always has its segments.
columns.loading: n/a: Segments are static choices; nothing loads.
columns.error: n/a: A segmented control always holds a valid choice.

columns.empty: n/a: A tooltip always names something; with no words, leave the tooltip out.
columns.loading: n/a: A tooltip shows a fixed label; it never loads.
columns.error: n/a: A tooltip names a control; the control shows its own error.

columns.empty: n/a: Hidden text with nothing in it is not rendered by its caller.
columns.loading: n/a: Hidden text draws nothing that loads.
columns.error: n/a: Hidden text takes no input and fetches nothing, so it cannot fail.
columns.overflow: n/a: The hidden box is clipped to nothing by design; the revealed chip is one line.
